defects.evidence: Multiple mutation guards accepted result.status != 0 without first rejecting spawnSync error, signal, or status=null; null != 0 therefore counted timeout/signal infrastructure failure as a killed mutant.
lifecycle-formal duplicated TLC outcome parsing instead of using the shared infrastructure-vs-semantic classifier and exact expected-invariant helper.
storage refinement returned literal true values for oneAccepted/maxSafeAccepted and described contention difference from requested operation counts instead of observed completion/durable state.
reset-race entry was signaled after assertions, finite claim drain was unbounded, and process-test exit waits could remain pending after an already-fired exit.

requiredFix: All mutation subprocess verdicts must fail closed on infrastructure outcomes, TLC paths must share exact outcome classification, proof booleans must derive from observations, and known race/drain/process waits must be explicitly bounded. The normal assurance gate must mutation-kill representative regressions of every class.
